title: ensureAppUserProvisioned always writes orphans into the default workforceap org
blast: Root layout calls this on every authenticated render. A custom-domain / second-org user whose users row is missing is created under getDefaultOrganizationId() (slug workforceap). Subsequent withTenantScope / RLS / GUC orgId then attach that person to the wrong tenant. Seat, PII, and admin lists leak across orgs the first time multi-tenant is real.
evidence: lib/member/ensureAppUser.ts:54 organizationId = await getDefaultOrganizationId(). app/layout.tsx:160 await ensureAppUserProvisioned(supabaseUser). No request-org or user.user_metadata org is consulted. getDefaultOrganizationId reads slug workforceap (lib/tenant/organization.ts:12-28).

title: Admin layout is global isAdmin(); many admin pages query all tenants
blast: isAdmin() does not check organizationId (lib/auth/roles.ts:40-45). app/admin/layout.tsx:35 gates on isAdmin only. Pages such as training-progress, placements, students, users, overview call prisma.*.findMany with no withTenantScope / organizationId. A second-org admin who is isAdmin() reads every member/placement/progress row. Partner pages were scoped after run_20260816; the rest of /admin was not.
evidence: app/admin/layout.tsx:35 isAdmin(user.id). app/admin/training-progress/page.tsx:42 isAdmin then :56-78 prisma.user.findMany take 5000, courseEnrollment take 5000, courseProgress take 20000 — no organizationId. app/admin/placements/page.tsx:64 isAdmin then :69 prisma.placementRecord.findMany take 500 no org filter. rg withTenantScope app/admin/training-progress app/admin/placements → no matches. isAdminInOrg exists at lib/auth/roles.ts:57-65 and is unused by these pages.

title: RLS GUC layer is off; app connects as table owner so policies do not bind
blast: Tenant isolation is application-only (withTenantScope proxy + route checks). Unscoped admin/cron/raw SQL reads every org. Comment in lib/db/prisma.ts:96-103: RLS enabled but NOT forced; GUC disabled after portal 504s. Enabling WAP_RLS_GUC_ENABLED without FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY + batched GUC either 504s the portal or fail-opens (lib/db/prisma.ts:155-167).
evidence: lib/db/prisma.ts:106 const gucEnabled = process.env.WAP_RLS_GUC_ENABLED === 'true'; early return skips $use. lib/db/prisma.ts:96-99 relforcerowsecurity=false, table owner bypasses RLS. lib/db/prisma.ts:163-167 fail-open log instead of throw. withTenantScope.ts:40-47 raw SQL and non-TENANT_SCOPED_MODELS pass through.

title: Rate-limit QA bypass ships a hardcoded default secret
blast: If WAP_RATE_LIMIT_QA_BYPASS=1 is set in a shared preview without rotating WAP_RATE_LIMIT_QA_SECRET, anyone who knows the committed default can send x-wap-qa-bypass and skip auth/forgot-password/contact limiters.
evidence: lib/rate-limit.ts:139-151 isQaBypassEnabled / getQaBypassSecret. Default string is 'wap-qa-dev-secret-do-not-use-in-production' at lib/rate-limit.ts:144. Bypass returns success:true at :160-162 before any Redis check.
